installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# Paper+Floodgate Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
PROJECT=paper
USER_AGENT="Pterodactyl (https://Pterodactyl.io)"

if [ -n "${DL_PATH}" ]; then
	echo -e "Using supplied download url: ${DL_PATH}"
	DOWNLOAD_URL=`eval echo $(echo ${DL_PATH} | sed -e 's/{{/${/g' -e 's/}}/}/g')`
else
	VER_EXISTS=`curl --user-agent "${USER_AGENT}" -s https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/${PROJECT} | jq -r --arg VERSION "${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" '.versions | any(.[]; index($VERSION))' | grep -m1 true`
	LATEST_VERSION=`curl --user-agent "${USER_AGENT}" -s https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/${PROJECT} | jq -r '.versions | to_entries | .[0].value[0]'`

	if [ "${VER_EXISTS}" = "true" ]; then
		echo -e "Version is valid. Using version ${MINECRAFT_VERSION}"
	else
		echo -e "Specified version not found. Defaulting to the latest ${PROJECT} version"
		MINECRAFT_VERSION=${LATEST_VERSION}
	fi

	BUILD_EXISTS=`curl --user-agent "${USER_AGENT}" -s https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/${PROJECT}/versions/${MINECRAFT_VERSION} | jq -r --arg BUILD "${BUILD_NUMBER}" '.builds[] | tostring | contains($BUILD)' | grep -m1 true`
	LATEST_BUILD=`curl --user-agent "${USER_AGENT}" -s https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/${PROJECT}/versions/${MINECRAFT_VERSION} | jq -r '.builds | .[0]'`

	if [ "${BUILD_EXISTS}" = "true" ]; then
		echo -e "Build is valid for version ${MINECRAFT_VERSION}. Using build ${BUILD_NUMBER}"
	else
		echo -e "Using the latest ${PROJECT} build for version ${MINECRAFT_VERSION}"
		BUILD_NUMBER=${LATEST_BUILD}
	fi

	echo "Version being downloaded"
	echo -e "Project: ${PROJECT}"
	echo -e "MC Version: ${MINECRAFT_VERSION}"
	echo -e "Build: ${BUILD_NUMBER}"
	DOWNLOAD_URL=`curl --user-agent "${USER_AGENT}" -s https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/${PROJECT}/versions/${MINECRAFT_VERSION}/builds/${BUILD_NUMBER} | jq -r '.downloads."server:default".url'`
fi

cd /mnt/server

echo -e "Running curl --user-agent \"${USER_AGENT}\" -o ${SERVER_JARFILE} ${DOWNLOAD_URL}"

if [ -f ${SERVER_JARFILE} ]; then
	mv ${SERVER_JARFILE} ${SERVER_JARFILE}.old
fi

curl --user-agent "${USER_AGENT}" -o ${SERVER_JARFILE} ${DOWNLOAD_URL}

if [ ! -f server.properties ]; then
	echo -e "Downloading MC server.properties"
	curl --user-agent "${USER_AGENT}" -o server.properties https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pterodactyl/game-eggs/main/minecraft/java/server.properties
fi


resolve_geysermc_build() {
	GEYSERMC_PROJECT="$1"
	PLATFORM="$2"
	OUT_JAR="$3"
	MC_VER="${MINECRAFT_VERSION}"
	MC_MAJOR=`echo "${MC_VER}" | sed -n 's/^\([0-9][0-9]*\.[0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p'`
	MC_ESC=`echo "${MC_VER}" | sed 's/\./\\./g'`
	MAJOR_ESC=`echo "${MC_MAJOR}" | sed 's/\./\\./g'`
	PLUGIN_VER=""
	BUILD_NUM=""
	FOUND=0
	for TIER in 1 2; do
		[ "${FOUND}" -eq 1 ] && break
		for PLUGIN_VER in `curl -sL "https://download.geysermc.org/v2/projects/${GEYSERMC_PROJECT}" | jq -r '.versions | reverse | .[]'`; do
			[ "${FOUND}" -eq 1 ] && break
			BUILDS_JSON=`curl -sL "https://download.geysermc.org/v2/projects/${GEYSERMC_PROJECT}/versions/${PLUGIN_VER}/builds"`
			for BUILD_NUM in `echo "${BUILDS_JSON}" | jq -r '.builds | reverse | .[].build'`; do
				HIT=`echo "${BUILDS_JSON}" | jq -r --argjson BN "${BUILD_NUM}" --arg MC "${MC_VER}" --arg MAJOR "${MC_MAJOR}" --arg MC_ESC "${MC_ESC}" --arg MAJOR_ESC "${MAJOR_ESC}" --argjson TIER "${TIER}" '
					def tier1:
					  (.summary | test("\\b" + $MC_ESC + "\\b"))
					  or (.summary | test("Initial " + $MC + "\\b"; "i"))
					  or ((.summary + " " + .message) | test("Java Edition " + $MC + "\\b"; "i"));
					def tier2:
					  ($MAJOR != "") and (
					    (.summary | test("Start on " + $MAJOR_ESC + "\\b"; "i"))
					    or ((.summary + " " + .message) | test($MAJOR_ESC + " support"; "i"))
					    or ((.summary + " " + .message) | test("Paper " + $MAJOR_ESC + "\\b"; "i"))
					  );
					.builds[] | select(.build == $BN) | .changes[] |
					select(if $TIER == 1 then tier1 else tier2 end) | .summary' | head -n 1`
				if [ -n "${HIT}" ]; then
					FOUND=1
					echo -e "Matched ${GEYSERMC_PROJECT} for MC ${MC_VER}: version ${PLUGIN_VER} build ${BUILD_NUM} (${HIT})"
					break
				fi
			done
		done
	done
	if [ "${FOUND}" -eq 0 ]; then
		PLUGIN_VER=latest
		BUILD_NUM=latest
		echo -e "No ${GEYSERMC_PROJECT} build matched MC ${MC_VER}; using latest"
	fi
	FILE_HASH=`curl -sL "https://download.geysermc.org/v2/projects/${GEYSERMC_PROJECT}/versions/${PLUGIN_VER}/builds/${BUILD_NUM}" | jq -r ".downloads.${PLATFORM}.sha256"`
	curl -o "${OUT_JAR}" -L "https://download.geysermc.org/v2/projects/${GEYSERMC_PROJECT}/versions/${PLUGIN_VER}/builds/${BUILD_NUM}/downloads/${PLATFORM}"
	echo "${FILE_HASH} ${OUT_JAR}" | sha256sum -c
	RESULT=$?
	if [ "${RESULT}" -ne 0 ]; then
		echo "SHA256 does not match! Aborting..."
		rm -f "${OUT_JAR}"
		exit 1
	fi
	echo "${GEYSERMC_PROJECT} SHA256 match"
}

mkdir -p plugins
echo -e "Downloading Floodgate"
resolve_geysermc_build floodgate spigot plugins/floodgate-spigot.jar
